validation.ownData: Closed finite own-data keys; exact primitive types/literals, nonnegative safe integers and finite lengths; reject holes/accessors/extras/symbols/coercion. Sequence order is exact; cross-realm prototype identity is irrelevant.
validation.bytes: Explicit UTF8 fixture bytes or base64 for arbitrary bytes; stdout/FS equality is exact, not digest-only evidence. Retain complete bounded byte artifacts and their length/digest bindings.
validation.identity: Thrown-reason references are checked Object.is/strict identity inside the live worker, including false/0/null/undefined and object tokens. JSON labels are reports, not reconstructed thrown objects or cancellation provenance.
validation.coverage: All32 author IDs exactly once in base case mapping; variants have unique subordinate IDs. Every A01..A12 scenario label maps to concrete extra cases or an explicit unresolved/nonpass obligation. Slots are coverage requirements, NOT10 executed cases.
validation.caseCount: Freeze matrix extra count and exact layout/backend/schedule-expanded denominator at handoff. 32 author plus N extras is distinct from invocation count and from data assertions. Duplicates/missing IDs or a count-only receipt refuse.
validation.acceptance: Expected status/rejection plus exact output and full namespace/byte effects gate before PASS; FS calls ordered where contract demands, no invented total counts. Parent finalization also requires complete, closed, intact, exact required IDs and retired owned handles.
validation.exclusions: Unsupported provider/API/unreachable-cap/opaque-work obligations are separate nonpasses with reasons, not dropped or converted into skips accepted as success.
validation.unresolved: Candidate API, author actual fixtures, matrix path/commit/bytes, diagnostic checker and driver are deliberately null in BINDING-v1.json; no HEAD inference
